Design Academy Eindhoven
Design Academy Eindhoven (DAE) is one of the world’s leading design schools, recognised internationally for its forward-thinking and renowned professors and alumni. Design Academy Eindhoven is a University of the Arts that specializes in Design and is part of the Dutch Universities of Applied Sciences. For over 70 years it has trained aspiring designers to make their mark on the future by thinking freely and openly about what design can achieve, consistently exploring design as an instrument of material, social, environmental and critical innovation. Design Academy’s values — co-participation, care, and pushing discourse forward — guide all aspects of how we work, learn and build community.

Bachelor & Master Open Day 2026
Find out more about our Bachelor and Master programmes during an in-person Open Day at DAE. Visitors will have the opportunity to meet current students and staff, see DAE's  facilities and workshops and ask questions. The Open Day is specifically designed to help you make the right choice when it comes to your future studies! The event will be split into separate groups for each programme.

Explore the Bachelors
How does it feel to study for one day at DAE? Explore the Bachelors is a day all about discovery - feeling a match between your personal interests and talents and the Academy, the tutors, the methods used and the current students. The day is designed to get insight on how DAE works, what a day of a student would look like, and what it takes to be a designer.

Public event
Bachelor Open Day 2026
On Friday 11 December, the DAE Bachelors Department welcomes prospective students for a full day of talks and tours. Are you interested in studying at DAE? Do you want to hear first-hand what student life is like in Eindhoven, or are you curious to know more about the application process?⁣
